items.work: La voce sola — songs from Opp. 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 and 8
items.label: Brilliant Classics, 96436
items.note: A survey of Strozzi’s books in chronological order, from Op. 2 to Op. 8, with Lagrime mie and what the label describes as the first recording of a piece without an opus number. The linked video is the complete album; the times below are the chapters given in its description.

items.performers: Mary Bevan, soprano; Elizabeth Kenny, theorbo; Orchestra of the Age of Enlightenment
items.label: Orchestra of the Age of Enlightenment
items.note: A performance by a soprano and a theorbo player, published on the orchestra’s own channel with details of its Strozzi concert at Kings Place, London. The piece is the lament that opens with the words “Lagrime mie”.

items.performers: Aurata Fonte; Anna Simboli and Miho Kamiya, sopranos; Andrea Arrivabene, alto; Perikli Pite, viola da gamba; Valeria Montanari, harpsichord; Giuseppe Monari, organ
items.label: Tactus, TC 611990
items.note: The label calls this the first complete recording of the book. It comprises fourteen motets for solo voice on two discs, from Mater Anna to Iubilemus, and includes Oleum effusum and Surgite, surgite.
